title: Race condition between Unity counter service and autostarted apps, causing them to sometimes lose their Task Manager notification badges until they're restarted
line: Apps that start automatically at login now keep the unread-count badge they set on their Task Manager icon.
explanation: The com.canonical.Unity service and the listener for LauncherEntry Update signals only existed once the Task Manager applet had loaded, about half a second after systemd starts XDG autostart apps (they are ordered after plasmashell's D-Bus name, not after its panels). A badge count an app broadcast at startup therefore had no receiver and was lost until the app sent a new one, and apps that check NameHasOwner(com.canonical.Unity) skipped sending at all. A new libtaskmanager class now owns com.canonical.Unity, listens for updates and keeps each app's last entry until it leaves the bus; plasmashell creates it in the ShellCorona constructor, before it takes org.kde.plasmashell, and the Task Manager applet reads the kept entries when it loads instead of registering the service itself.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: own com.canonical.Unity from plasmashell startup

Apps autostarted at login sent their badge count before the Task
Manager had loaded, so it was lost. Own com.canonical.Unity from the
start of plasmashell and keep each app's last entry for it to read.

BUG: 462735

applets/taskmanager: read Unity launcher entries from libtaskmanager

The applet registered com.canonical.Unity itself and missed any badge
sent before it loaded, such as by apps autostarted at login. Use the
entries libtaskmanager keeps from plasmashell startup instead.

BUG: 462735

media.caption: Pure master: an autostarted app sent count=7 for Discover at login, but the Discover launcher has no badge
With the fix: same autostart entry, the Discover launcher shows the 7 badge after login

review.text: Addresses the real cause: the Unity receiver only existed once the Task Manager applet loaded, so it now lives in libtaskmanager, is owned from the ShellCorona constructor (before org.kde.plasmashell, which autostart is ordered after), and keeps each app's last entry for the applet to replay. The applet side is a clean simplification (no more QDBusContext or its own watcher), autostart timing is untouched, and plasmawindowed/Latte keep their old fallback behaviour. Before/after shots and the 3/3 login verification with regression checks (sender exit, live updates, shell restart) show the bug and the fix. The two commits must land together, and the non-systemd plasma_session path only narrows the window, which is acceptable.
